dimensions.assessment: Plan defines observable source-effect, reconciliation, identity, UI and connected-user acceptance scenarios; implementation receipts are correctly deferred to Done.
Tasks cover shared read integration, journal-gated explicit effects, conversation distinctions and rollout. Dependency work for #51/#52/#57/#88 stays within the stated authorization.

Appropriate backend, protocol, persistence/race, restart/reconciliation, direct-route and browser/keyboard/narrow-layout tests are planned. Physical-phone rehearsal is explicitly waived; real connected-user proof is not.
Full verify, configured identity CI and independent review are planned for implementation acceptance; not improperly demanded as Plan receipts.

The existing guarded .NET parent retains credentials and per-initiation authorization; the tokenless bounded SDK child has explicit callbacks and exact-effect scope. Ephemeral login semantics, no-resend uncertainty, actual-user attribution and permission consent boundaries are preserved.

Shared released Lighthouse SDK remains sole policy authority for eligibility, reservations, current questions, admission and deduplication. Read-only adoption may precede persistence. SQLite/source writes remain blocked on maintainer acceptance of Proposed ADR-0008 and concrete journal design; this review does not accept it. Compatible public release/adoption remains pending; #119 source qualification is not registry release or App-user acceptance.
Realized architecture and operational/rollback documentation are scheduled after accepted implementation, through owning workflows.

The proposal/spec preserve explicit effects, source authority, uncertainty, distinct comment/continuation, human decisions and unsupported/unknown states. Historical read-only issue evidence is not elevated to current policy.
Plan identifies exact release, hosted checks and real connected-App-user evidence needed later. No future implementation evidence is treated as a planning prerequisite.
Maintainer ADR/design acceptance, new development App-permission owner consent, protected publication decisions and actual App-user acceptance remain separate gates; the plan does not waive them.

Production remains at 58; production custody/deployment remain #58. No journal retention policy is invented; logical SQLite cap does not claim to cap WAL/key storage. Existing uncertain claims are reconciliation-only and never resend.
